recovered_failed_nodeids.note: The tail -25 window happened to contain the complete short test summary, so all 14 failed node ids were recorded. This means the 2026-08-31 failure DISTRIBUTION is also transcript-attested, not merely project-reported. It does NOT mean the full stdout was captured.

recorded_shell_command_note: The recovered text is a SHELL COMMAND, not process argv. PYTHONPATH=src is an environment assignment and never enters sys.argv. `V` was a shell variable resolved to .venv/bin/python. The actual process argv was NOT captured.

exit_code_status.reason: The command ends in `2>&1 | tail -25`. With no `set -o pipefail` and no PIPESTATUS inspection, the shell reports tail's status, not pytest's.
exit_code_status.also_not_a_substitute: The Bash tool's own is_error=false does NOT stand in for pytest's return code either — it reflects the tool invocation, not the piped process. Only the RESULT TEXT may be bound to this run; no exit code may.
